name: Scoreboard UI
author: Md. Shahinur Islam

sections.description:
Scoreboard UI is a lightweight yet feature-rich WordPress plugin that allows you to create and display scoreboards for a wide range of sports directly on your website.

Whether you run a sports blog, club website, or news portal, this plugin helps you present scores in a clean and professional way.

Supported sports include:
Soccer, Cricket, Basketball, Tennis, Baseball, Golf, Volleyball, Badminton, Swimming, Boxing, Table Tennis, Rugby, Ice Hockey, MMA, Cycling, Archery, Gymnastics, Wrestling, and many more.

You can easily customize and display scoreboards using shortcodes—no programming knowledge required.

Key Features

  • Supports 50+ sports scoreboards
  • Easy-to-use interface in WordPress admin
  • Shortcode support for flexible placement
  • Fully responsive design (mobile-friendly)
  • Lightweight and fast performance
  • Clean and modern UI
  • No coding skills needed

Why Choose Scoreboard UI?

Scoreboard UI gives you complete control over how sports scores are displayed on your website. It is designed to be simple for beginners while still flexible for advanced users.

  • Perfect for sports websites and blogs
  • Quick setup and easy management
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Regular updates and improvements

Demo Video

Docs & Support

  • Plugin Page: https://wordpress.org/plugins/scoreboard-ui
  • Documentation & Source: https://gitlab.com/shahinurislam/scoreboard-ui
  • Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/scoreboard-ui

sections.installation:
1. Upload the scoreboard-ui folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start creating scoreboards from the admin panel.
sections.faq:
Is Scoreboard UI responsive?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on all devices including mobile and tablets.

What does this plugin do?

Scoreboard UI allows you to create and display sports scoreboards on your WordPress website.
